meta.name: debugging-wizard
meta.description: Parses error messages, traces execution flow through stack traces, correlates log entries to identify failure points, and applies systematic hypothesis-driven methodology to isolate and resolve bugs. Use when investigating errors, analyzing stack traces, finding root causes of unexpected behavior, troubleshooting crashes, or performing log analysis, error investigation, or root cause analysis.

copy.tagline: 解析错误信息，追踪执行流，定位并修复代码缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从堆栈跟踪和日志中找出代码问题的根源
copy.tagline_en: Parse error messages, trace execution flow, and fix bugs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to find root causes from stack traces and logs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像专业调试员一样分析错误信息、追踪堆栈、关联日志，用假设驱动的方法一步步找出并修复代码中的 bug。
howto.when: 当你描述错误、异常、崩溃或代码不工作时，Claude 会主动启动调试流程。

say.text: 我的 Python 脚本在第 42 行报错，帮我看看堆栈。
say.note: Claude 会解析错误并给出调试步骤。

say.text: 这个 bug 时有时无，帮我用二分法找到引入它的提交。
say.note: Claude 会指导你使用 git bisect。

say.text: Node.js 服务崩溃了，帮我分析日志找根因。
say.note: Claude 会关联日志并定位故障点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an expert debugger: it parses error messages, traces stack traces, correlates logs, and applies a systematic hypothesis-driven methodology to isolate and resolve bugs in any codebase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe errors, exceptions, crashes, or code not working. Claude will initiate the debugging workflow.

say_en.text: My Python script errors at line 42, help me check the stack trace.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the error and suggest debugging steps.

say_en.text: This bug is intermittent, help me use binary search to find the introducing commit.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through git bisect.

say_en.text: Node.js service crashed, help me analyze logs to find root cause.
say_en.note: Claude will correlate logs and pinpoint the failure.
